texts.fortiguard-psirt:https://fortiguard.fort:
Linux kernel RCE CVE-2026-98432
CVSSv3 Score:
9.8
CVE-2026-98432:ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock() transfers ownership of ireq->ireq_opt to the child socket (newinet->inet_opt) without copying it. Another cpu can concurrently process a retransmitted SYN for the same request socket, and send a SYNACK from tcp_check_req(). tcp_v4_send_synack() and inet_csk_route_req() read ireq->ireq_opt under rcu_read_lock() only, and ip_build_and_send_pkt() and ip_options_build() then read opt->optlen twice. Note that the SYNACK timer itself is not an issue: it holds a reference on its request socket, and inet_csk_reqsk_queue_drop() calls timer_delete_sync() before the child can be freed. Since commit 079096f103fa ("tcp/dccp: install syn_recv requests into ehash table"), request sockets are processed without holding the listener lock, so nothing prevents the child socket from being freed while the SYNACK is still being built. TCP child sockets do not have SOCK_RCU_FREE, and inet_sock_destruct() frees inet_opt with a plain kfree(), leading to a use-after-free in ip_options_build(). A similar issue exists with request socket migration (net.ipv4.tcp_migrate_req=1, or a BPF_SK_REUSEPORT_SELECT_OR_MIGRATE program). reqsk_timer_handler() clones the request socket with inet_reqsk_clone(), so that the old request socket and its clone share the same ireq_opt, then reqsk_migrate_reset() clears the pointer in the old one. Another cpu holding a reference on the old request socket can still be using these options (sending a SYNACK, or creating a child in tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock()) when the clone is freed, and tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor() also uses a plain kfree(). Readers already use RCU, and other paths replacing inet_opt (do_ip_setsockopt(), cipso_v4_sock_setattr()...) already use kfree_rcu(). Use kfree_rcu() in inet_sock_destruct() and tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor() as well. IPv6 is not affected by the first issue, because tcp_v6_syn_recv_sock() duplicates the options. tcp_v6_reqsk_destructor() has the same migration issue with ipv6_opt, which is only set by CALIPSO. This will be addressed in a separate patch.

Linux Kernel: Mehrere Schwachstellen
Ein Angreifer kann mehrere Schwachstellen im Linux Kernel ausnutzen, um einen Denial of Service Angriff durchzuführen oder Root-Rechte zu erlangen.

en.title: Linux kernel: vulnerabilities in IPv4 networking and other subsystems
en.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities were discovered in the Linux kernel, which could allow an attacker to compromise the system, cause a denial of service, or execute unauthorized code.
en.impact: An attacker can execute unauthorized code or commands, compromise the system, or cause a denial of service.
en.fix: Update the Linux kernel packages to the versions specified in the respective vendor advisories, such as `4.15.0-1162.173~16.04.1` for Ubuntu 16.04 LTS Oracle systems.
checks: Inventory Linux kernel packages across all systems.
Verify if running systems are using vulnerable kernel versions.
Apply the appropriate kernel updates provided by the vendor.

ru.title: Ядро Linux: уязвимости в сетевой подсистеме IPv4 и других компонентах
ru.summary: В ядре Linux обнаружены множественные уязвимости, которые могут позволить злоумышленнику скомпрометировать систему, вызвать отказ в обслуживании или выполнить несанкционированный код.
ru.impact: Злоумышленник может выполнить несанкционированный код или команды, скомпрометировать систему либо вызвать отказ в обслуживании.
ru.fix: Обновите пакеты ядра Linux до версий, указанных в соответствующих бюллетенях производителя, например до `4.15.0-1162.173~16.04.1` для систем Ubuntu 16.04 LTS Oracle.
checks: Проведите инвентаризацию пакетов ядра Linux на всех системах.
Проверьте, используют ли работающие системы уязвимые версии ядра.
Примените соответствующие обновления ядра, предоставленные производителем.

de.title: Linux-Kernel: Schwachstellen in IPv4-Netzwerken und anderen Subsystemen
de.summary: Im Linux-Kernel wurden mehrere Schwachstellen entdeckt, die es einem Angreifer ermöglichen könnten, das System zu kompromizieren, einen Denial-of-Service zu verursachen oder Code auszuführen.
de.impact: Ein Angreifer kann unautorisierten Code oder Befehle ausführen, das System kompromizieren oder einen Denial of Service verursachen.
de.fix: Aktualisieren Sie die Linux-Kernel-Pakete auf die in den jeweiligen Herstellermeldungen angegebenen Versionen, wie `4.15.0-1162.173~16.04.1` für Ubuntu 16.04 LTS Oracle-Systeme.
checks: Inventarisieren Sie Linux-Kernel-Pakete auf allen Systemen.
Überprüfen Sie, ob laufende Systeme anfällige Kernel-Versionen verwenden.
Wenden Sie die vom Hersteller bereitgestellten Kernel-Updates an.
